google_chrome.postinst_behavior: Creates google-chrome.sources (URI chrome-stable/deb, Signed-By /usr/share/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg); removes or comments its legacy google-chrome.list. With repo_add_once=false and neither package-managed source filename present, it adds no source. An existing google-chrome.sources forces recreation even with repo_add_once=false.
google_chrome.repair: The helper owns native-stack-google-chrome.sources, checks the primary fingerprint, uses restricted Signed-By, disables repo_add_once before apt installation, preserves other defaults and refuses pre-existing package-managed source files. It installs current stable and records the installed version; acceptance checks minimum 154.0.8037.97-1 plus Google repository origin, without an exact build pin.
google_chrome.execution: Downloaded, digest-verified and extracted control files only; package and postinst were never installed or executed.
